correctness.rationale: The algorithm update under B=0 and B=1 gives A0=[[1,0,-gamma],[1,1,-1],[0,0,1]], A1=[[1-gamma,-gamma,0],[0,0,0],[1,1,0]]. On symmetric second moments the 6x6 map satisfies det(I-M)=gamma*q^2*((q-1)*gamma^2+(7q-8)*gamma+6q-4), checked independently by symbolic algebra. For q>2/3 the displayed positive-definite P solves internal Lyapunov equation at gamma=0; the unique slow moment eigenvalue has derivative -2; PSD cone continuity and positive eigenvalue prevent a hidden crossing before gamma_*(q). The negative determinant outside the root forces real spectral eigenvalue >1. For 0<q<1, A0 has a single length-three unipotent Jordan chain and A1 breaks both proper invariant subspaces, ensuring positive-definite adjoint Perron eigenmatrix, then primal-square identity forces auxiliary decay if primal decays, contradiction. q=1 reduces to ordinary gradient descent after finite transients. Direct symbolic determinant, Lyapunov, and sampled spectral tests corroborate, not replace proof.
